title: Everyday Phrases — Going Live Online
title_quote: I want to go live online.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】📱 實用開直播必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱B1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Going Live Online
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用開直播情境對話：從註冊開播權限、選品排腳本、調燈試鏡，到直播帶貨、下播復盤（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Going Live Online phrase pairs — from setting up your seller account and gear, to camera tests, live selling, and post-stream review (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to go live online.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your first stream is a big step.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr fɜːrst striːm ɪz ə bɪɡ stɛp./
dialogue.zh: 第一次直播可是重要的一步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I downloaded the app this morning.
dialogue.zh: 我今天早上下載了那個App。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you make an account yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I signed up with my email.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You also need a phone number.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app sent me a code.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enter the code to verify it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my profile set up right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add a clear photo and a bio.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ə klɪr ˈfoʊtoʊ ənd ə ˈbaɪoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 加一張清楚的照片和簡介。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What name should I use?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick a short, easy one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need permission to sell?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, apply for seller access.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They asked for my ID card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ æskt fər maɪ aɪ di ˈkɑːrd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Upload a photo of it there.
dialogue.zh: 在那一欄上傳照片就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does the review take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually one or two days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The approval notice just came.
dialogue.zh: 通過審核的通知剛剛來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you can go live and sell.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ju kæn ɡoʊ laɪv ənd sɛl./
dialogue.zh: 現在你能開直播賣貨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which products should I sell first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with one simple category.
dialogue.zh: 先從一個簡單的品類入手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe warm clothes and bags.
dialogue.zh: 也許是保暖的衣服和包包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Choose things you know well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I ordered three sample products.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try them before showing them live.
dialogue.zh: 直播展示前先自己試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I write a stream script?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plan each part of it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First the greeting, then the demos.
dialogue.zh: 先打招呼，再進示範環節。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save the best item for last.
dialogue.zh: 把最好的商品留到最後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long should the show run?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours is a good start.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I made a timeline for the night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ meɪd ə ˈtaɪmˌlaɪn fər ðə naɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stick to it and stay calm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What sale deals should I run?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A discount for early buyers works.
dialogue.zh: 給早下單的折扣很管用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free shipping helps too, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, people love free shipping.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's set up the lights.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ring light makes you glow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the ring light bright enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it to the middle level.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I place the light?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it just behind your phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen looks a bit dark.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add a small side light too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tripod came in the box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set the legs out wide.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the phone clipped on tight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a gentle shake test.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕搖一下試試穩不穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My desk looks too messy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang the backdrop cloth up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The plain gray one looks clean.
dialogue.zh: 純灰色那塊看起來很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It also hides the clutter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my products be visible?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stack a few boxes on the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæk ə fjuː ˈbɑːksɪz ɑːn ðə saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whole setup looks pro now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It cost almost nothing, though.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's test the internet speed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Run the speed test app now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My upload speed looks low.
dialogue.zh: 我的上傳速度好像偏低。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A stream needs strong upload.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe move closer to the router.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one wall is too far.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The speed is much better now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still keep a backup plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use my phone hotspot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it saves a dead Wi-Fi.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the data plan big enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours live eats a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I bought extra data today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart move for a first show.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close other apps while streaming.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even downloads will slow it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I plug in the charger?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, live video drains battery.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The phone stays cool so far.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, hot phones lag a lot.
dialogue.zh: 那就好，手機發燙會卡得厲害。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I picked Friday for my first show.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pɪkt ˈfraɪdeɪ fər maɪ fɜːrst ʃoʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight o'clock that night is perfect.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two days left to prepare.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Make your checklist and finish it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wrote down every task.
dialogue.zh: 我把每件事都寫下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing left to chance now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a co-host?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two voices keep viewers longer.
dialogue.zh: 兩個人說話更能留住觀眾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you help me on camera?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll hold the products.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You'll answer chat for me too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave the comments to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This feels big but exciting.
dialogue.zh: 這件事很大，但很讓人興奮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone starts somewhere, you know.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm going to trust my prep.
dialogue.zh: 我要相信自己做的準備。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the right attitude.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's rehearse the opening lines.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with a warm hello.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello friends, welcome to my store.
dialogue.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到我的小店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sounded smooth and natural.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think we're truly ready.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得我們真的準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost — tomorrow we test the camera.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll set two alarms the night before.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛt tuː əˈlɑːrmz ðə naɪt bɪˈfɔːr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll be there right at noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, let's open the camera app.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your face is on the screen.
dialogue.zh: 你的臉出現在螢幕上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the picture sharp or blurry?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks a little soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the lens has fingerprints.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it with a soft cloth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better? The edges look clean now.
dialogue.zh: 好點了嗎？邊緣都清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, much sharper than before.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you tap to focus, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll tap on your face now.
dialogue.zh: 我點一下你臉上的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The focus jumped around twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lock the focus before we start.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now you stand in front.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Am I too close to the phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ tuː kloʊs tu ðə foʊn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move back one small step.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the frame feels right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The side light leaves a shadow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I move a little left?
dialogue.zh: 我要不要往左邊挪一點？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, I'll raise the light a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, aɪl reɪz ðə laɪt ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不用，我把燈抬高一點就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, no shadows now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's hear the microphone next.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say something to test it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, two — can you hear me?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your voice sounds a bit hollow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's an echo in the room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clothes can absorb the echo.
dialogue.zh: 掛幾件衣服能吸掉回聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I move the mic closer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep it near your mouth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this — is the echo gone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's gone, that fixed it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wear headphones to monitor sound.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I hear what they hear.
dialogue.zh: 這樣我能聽到觀眾聽到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The volume level feels just right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't shout, keep talking easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the mic dies live?
dialogue.zh: 要是直播中麥克風沒聲了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep a spare mic charged up.
dialogue.zh: 備一支充好電的麥克風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I taped the cables down.
dialogue.zh: 我用膠帶把線固定好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No tripping during the show.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's practice with cue cards.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I made them big and bold.
dialogue.zh: 我把牌上的字做得又大又粗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does this first card say?
dialogue.zh: 第一塊牌子上寫了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says slow down and smile.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And this one with the clock?
dialogue.zh: 那個畫著時鐘的是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means wrap it up soon.
dialogue.zh: 意思是提醒我該收尾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the cards near the phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: High enough for you to see.
dialogue.zh: 舉高到你用眼角能看到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I go off track, signal me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ ɡoʊ ɔːf træk, ˈsɪɡnəl miː./
dialogue.zh: 我要是聊偏了，就提示我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One quick tap on the board.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's record a short test clip.
dialogue.zh: 先錄一段短的測試影片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Play it back and listen closely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The test clip looked great.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sound was clean, picture was sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we passed the camera check?
dialogue.zh: 所以鏡頭測試全部通過了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every technical thing works now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do we press start?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight o'clock, exactly on time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Starting on time feels professional.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So have everything up by seven.
dialogue.zh: 所以七點前一切要就位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll do a final gear sweep.
dialogue.zh: 我會最後檢查一遍設備。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll set the sale links ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water and tissues by the desk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you'll need them during the show.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, juːl niːd ðɛm ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə ʃoʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we plan a countdown?
dialogue.zh: 要不要再發一條倒數預告？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Post that you start at eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I shared it on my page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friends can spread the word.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's five to eight now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deep breath, you've got this.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me start the camera app.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Confirm the title and cover photo.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten seconds left, get set.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five, four, three, two…

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One — we are live now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The viewer counter just started.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smile, the red dot is on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hello everyone, so glad you're here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands won't stay still.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody can see them, relax.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We made it past the start.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hardest part is over.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I look calm on camera?
dialogue.zh: 我鏡頭裡看起來鎮定嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You look like a pro already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my voice coming through clear?
dialogue.zh: 我的聲音傳出去清楚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crystal clear, no echo at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chat is already moving fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? They like your opening.
dialogue.zh: 看到沒？他們喜歡你的開場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They ask if I'm a real person.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ æsk ɪf aɪm ə riːl ˈpɜːrsən./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave and show them your hands.
dialogue.zh: 揮揮手，給他們看看雙手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This camera test was worth it.
dialogue.zh: 這場鏡頭測試太值得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No surprises once we went live.
dialogue.zh: 開播後一點意外都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hundred people are watching now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep that energy, you're doing great.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone asks if I do this often.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn æsks ɪf aɪ du ðɪs ˈɔːfən./
dialogue.zh: 有人問我是不是常開直播。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them it's your very first show.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɛl ðɛm ɪts jʊr ˈvɛri fɜːrst ʃoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 告訴他們這是你的第一場直播。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All the prep really paid off.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It did, now let's sell some stuff.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dɪd, naʊ lɛts sɛl sʌm stʌf./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before we sell, quick lens check.
dialogue.zh: 開賣前再快檢查一次鏡頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean, bright, steady — all good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, more friends just joined us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell us where you're watching from.
dialogue.zh: 告訴我們你們在哪裡看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A fan joined all the way from Taichung.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fæn dʒɔɪnd ɔːl ðə weɪ frʌm taɪˈtʃʊŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say hi to them on air.
dialogue.zh: 在直播裡跟他們問個好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi Taichung, thanks for coming.
dialogue.zh: 台中的朋友你好，謝謝前來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask them to hit the follow button.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðɛm tu hɪt ðə ˈfɑːloʊ ˈbʌtən./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Follow so you won't miss a drop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɑːloʊ soʊ ju woʊnt mɪs ə drɑːp./
dialogue.zh: 關注了才不會錯過上新。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Share the stream with a friend too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛr ðə striːm wɪð ə frɛnd tuː./
dialogue.zh: 也順便分享給一個朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our numbers keep climbing up.
dialogue.zh: 在線人數一直在往上爬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three hundred now, still rising.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The likes are flying in fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That pushes you to more people.
dialogue.zh: 這會把你推給更多觀眾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's talk about this first item.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The soft cotton hoodie, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at how soft the fabric is.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt haʊ sɔːft ðə ˈfæbrɪk ɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub it near the camera lens.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll wear it so you can see.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl wɛr ɪt soʊ ju kæn ˈsiː./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand back for the full view.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fit looks relaxed and neat.
dialogue.zh: 版型看起來寬鬆又俐落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which colors do you have?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two colors: beige and green.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the classic beige one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beige looks soft on my skin.
dialogue.zh: 米色在我的膚色上很柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It glows warm under the light.
dialogue.zh: 燈下看著暖暖的很溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next try the deep forest green.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That shade works all year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chat asks: does it run small?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good question, answer them now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It fits true, not small at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fɪts truː, nɑːt smɔːl æt ɔːl./
dialogue.zh: 尺碼標準，一點都不偏小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Suggest they check the size chart.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the size chart link?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I pinned it at the top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone asks: is it see-through?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the fabric is thick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A viewer asks about tall sizes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them XL is longer here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ðɛm ˌɛks ˈɛl ɪz ˈlɔːŋɡər hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 告訴他們加大碼會更長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chat asks: can I buy one to gift?
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃæt æsks kæn aɪ baɪ wʌn tu ɡɪft?/
dialogue.zh: 彈幕問：可以買來送人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it comes in a nice box.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt kʌmz ɪn ə naɪs bɑːks./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's open the sale link now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Number one, tap and grab it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The link is live on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɪŋk ɪz laɪv ɑːn ðə skrin./
dialogue.zh: 連結已經掛在畫面上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them stock is limited today.
dialogue.zh: 告訴他們今天庫存有限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A viewer wants the link again.
dialogue.zh: 有觀眾想再要一次連結。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The link is back up at the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɪŋk ɪz bæk ʌp æt ðə tɑːp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only fifty pieces left, friends.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half sold in five minutes flat.
dialogue.zh: 整整五分鐘就賣了一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The stock counter keeps dropping.
dialogue.zh: 庫存數字一直在往下掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That urgency sells more pieces.
dialogue.zh: 這種緊迫感能多賣幾件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold out! The first color's gone.
dialogue.zh: 售罄！第一個顏色賣光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Congratulate the buyers out loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yay to the fast fingers today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Others can join the next drop.
dialogue.zh: 其他人可以等下次上架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, the video just froze.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your audio cut out too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I close the app now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Restart the app, quick and calm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, we're back — can you hear?
dialogue.zh: 好，我們回來了——聽得到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type one if the stream is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪp wʌn ɪf ðə striːm ɪz faɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chat filled with ones, wow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody left while we were down.
dialogue.zh: 卡掉的時候竟然沒人走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We lost maybe two minutes there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show the price card again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry for that, back to it.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉剛才斷線，我們繼續。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same deal, still half price today.
dialogue.zh: 優惠不變，今天還是半價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a big gift just came in.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ə bɪɡ ɡɪft dʒʌst keɪm ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 看，一個大禮物剛飛進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank the sender by name.
dialogue.zh: 要念出送禮人的名字道謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, Lily, for the roses!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Viewers love being noticed live.
dialogue.zh: 觀眾最喜歡被主播點名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Another gift, this is exciting.
dialogue.zh: 又一個禮物，太讓人興奮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep thanking, but stay on product.
dialogue.zh: 感謝要繼續，但別離開產品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A fan sent us ten little stars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fæn sɛnt ʌs tɛn ˈlɪtəl stɑːrz./
dialogue.zh: 有粉絲送了十顆小星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blow them a thank-you kiss.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gifts are sweet, but buy the hoodie.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪfts ɑːr ˈswiːt, bʌt baɪ ðə ˈhʊdi./
dialogue.zh: 禮物很甜，但先買衛衣哦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You turned the joke into a sale.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tɜːrnd ðə dʒoʊk ˈɪntuː ə ˈseɪl./
dialogue.zh: 你把玩笑變成了一筆訂單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone asks how to wash it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold water, gentle cycle, air dry.
dialogue.zh: 冷水、溫和模式、自然晾乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it shrink after a wash?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the fabric is pre-shrunk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read them the buyer reviews.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four point nine stars, five hundred reviews.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔːr pɔɪnt naɪn stɑːrz, faɪv ˈhʌndrəd rɪˈvjuːz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That builds trust, for sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? The orders are coming in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten sold in the last minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call out the numbers, people love that.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔːl aʊt ðə ˈnʌmbərz, ˈpipəl lʌv ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 大聲報數，觀眾愛聽這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're trending in the live list!
dialogue.zh: 我們衝進直播熱門榜了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means fresh eyes keep coming.
dialogue.zh: 會有源源不絕的新觀眾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi to all the new faces here.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ tu ɔːl ðə nuː ˈfeɪsəz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 跟新進來的朋友問個好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give them a quick recap, kindly.
dialogue.zh: 請親切地幫他們補一下進度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're selling the cloud hoodie tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Link two has green back in stock.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪŋk tuː hæz ɡrin bæk ɪn stɑːk./
dialogue.zh: 二號連結的綠色已補貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My voice is getting tired already.
dialogue.zh: 我的嗓子已經有點累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sip your water, I'll take the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪp jʊr ˈwɔːtər, aɪl teɪk ðə flɔːr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Halfway through, still strong.
dialogue.zh: 播到一半，氣氛還是很熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last hour is the biggest one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst ˈaʊər ɪz ðə ˈbɪɡɪst wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 最後一個小時才是最旺的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's save the star item for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ˈseɪv ðə stɑːr ˈaɪtəm fər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 把王牌商品留到現在上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect timing, the room is packed.
dialogue.zh: 時機剛好，在線的人滿滿的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is tonight's champion item.
dialogue.zh: 這件就是今晚的冠軍商品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Demo it well and close strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This price is only live tonight.
dialogue.zh: 這個價只有今晚直播才有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And that, friends, is a wrap.
dialogue.zh: 就這樣，朋友們，今晚完美收工。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And we are finally off the air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wi ɑːr ˈfaɪnəli ɔːf ði ˈɛr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You were amazing out there.
dialogue.zh: 你剛剛在鏡頭前太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My heart is still beating fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down, let's read the numbers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the stream insights page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, look at this peak.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz, lʊk æt ðɪs ˈpiːk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many watched at the top?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight hundred at nine o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight hundred feels unreal.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Total views crossed two thousand.
dialogue.zh: 觀看總次數突破了兩千。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What was the favorite moment?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The restock drop, orders spiked there.
dialogue.zh: 補貨上架那段，訂單暴增。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the average watch time?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve minutes, a solid number.
dialogue.zh: 十二分鐘，這個數字很扎實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is twelve minutes good for a first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz twɛlv ˈmɪnɪts ɡʊd fər ə fɜːrst?/
dialogue.zh: 首播來看，十二分鐘算好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New streams usually sit at five.
dialogue.zh: 新主播通常只有五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We more than doubled that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And check the new follower count.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hundred and twenty new ones.
dialogue.zh: 新增了一百二十個粉絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a growth engine right there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many messages came in chat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Over a thousand, you were busy.
dialogue.zh: 超過一千條，你今晚忙壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me see the sales summary.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety-six orders before midnight.
dialogue.zh: 午夜前一共有九十六筆訂單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the green sell out again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, all forty pieces vanished.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope the payment page held.
dialogue.zh: 希望結帳頁面沒出問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two people said it glitched once.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Message them a private link.
dialogue.zh: 私訊發一個專屬連結給他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, both just paid already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the boring but real part.
dialogue.zh: 接下來是無聊但真實的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Returns will come, that's normal.
dialogue.zh: 退貨一定會來，這很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's our return policy again?
dialogue.zh: 我們的退貨政策是什麼來著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven days, tags still on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any return requests so far?
dialogue.zh: 到目前有人申請退貨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one wrong size, we fixed it.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn rɔːŋ ˈsaɪz, wi ˈfɪkst ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 只有一件尺碼不合，已處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say it clearly next time, please.
dialogue.zh: 下次請把這點講得更清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, put it on a cue card.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, pʊt ɪt ɑːn ə kjuː kɑːrd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do we ship these orders?
dialogue.zh: 這些訂單什麼時候發貨？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Within two days, the label prints tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪˈðɪn tuː deɪz, ðə ˈleɪbəl prɪnts təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 兩天內，託運標籤今晚就能印好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the courier pick up today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow morning, first run.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some ask about the delivery time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them three to five days.
dialogue.zh: 告訴他們三到五天送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A buyer messaged about a zipper.
dialogue.zh: 有位顧客私訊拉鏈的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Answer kindly, offer an exchange.
dialogue.zh: 親切地回覆，主動提出換貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After the sale, the work starts.
dialogue.zh: 賣出去之後，服務才剛開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good care brings buyers back.
dialogue.zh: 照顧好顧客，他們才會回頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's replay the recording now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch where the graph dips.
dialogue.zh: 盯住曲線往下掉的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We lost fifty people before nine?
dialogue.zh: 九點前那段掉了五十人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's when you read the chart silently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts wɛn ju rɛd ðə tʃɑːrt ˈsaɪləntli./
dialogue.zh: 那時你在低頭看尺碼表沒出聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, dead air pushes people out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep talking while your hands move.
dialogue.zh: 手在動的時候也要繼續講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When did they come back?
dialogue.zh: 觀眾後來什麼時候回來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right when the restock went up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fresh stock pulls the crowd back.
dialogue.zh: 補新貨能把人重新拉回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plan a restock every half hour.
dialogue.zh: 以後每半小時安排一次補貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That freeze hurt us, didn't it?
dialogue.zh: 畫面卡住那段確實有影響，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but you recovered fast.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，但你馬上穩住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What equipment should we upgrade?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ring light flickers on camera.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A new bulb is a cheap fix.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nuː bʌlb ɪz ə tʃip fɪks./
dialogue.zh: 換個新燈泡就能省錢搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Order one, and a second light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tripod wobbles when I move.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get the metal one, not plastic.
dialogue.zh: 換金屬的，別再買塑膠的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A mic arm steadies the sound.
dialogue.zh: 桌上再加支麥克風懸臂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hands-free is nicer live.
dialogue.zh: 對，直播時解放雙手更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any fix for the internet cuts?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the router into this room.
dialogue.zh: 把路由器挪到這間房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also learn the reconnect button.
dialogue.zh: 還要熟練那個重連按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Practice it until it's muscle memory.
dialogue.zh: 練到成為肌肉記憶為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, shorter intro, faster demo.
dialogue.zh: 下次開場短一點，示範快一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, viewers hate long warmups.
dialogue.zh: 認同，觀眾最討厭拖太長的開場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write tonight's lessons down now.
dialogue.zh: 把今晚的教訓馬上記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One page, five clear fixes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you free next Friday?
dialogue.zh: 下週五你有空再一起開播嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same time, eight o'clock again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's tease it in the story today.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts tiːz ɪt ɪn ðə ˈstɔːri təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天就發限時動態預告。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Post the countdown sticker too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Film a short teaser for it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen seconds, the green hoodie only.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What products go in the next show?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈprɑːdʌkts ɡoʊ ɪn ðə nɛkst ʃoʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The scarf set and the tote bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skɑːrf sɛt ənd ðə toʊt bæɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring back the hoodie for restock.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People will ask if we don't.
dialogue.zh: 不上的話他們肯定會問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Invite tonight's buyers to follow us.
dialogue.zh: 邀請今晚買過的人按關注。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They'll bring friends, that's free growth.
dialogue.zh: 他們會帶朋友來，這是免費流量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't wait for next Friday.
dialogue.zh: 我已經迫不及待下週五了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sound like a real host now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju saʊnd laɪk ə riːl hoʊst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你現在聽著就像個專業主播。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're building this one show at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪr ˈbɪldɪŋ ðɪs wʌn ʃoʊ æt ə taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我們一場一場把小生意做起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight proved the model works.
dialogue.zh: 今晚證明了這套做法可行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save the data, print the chart.
dialogue.zh: 把數據存檔，圖表打印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's our map for the next run.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈaʊər mæp fər ðə nɛkst rʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這是我們下一場的藍圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same team, same slot next week.
dialogue.zh: 下週同一班人，同一時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same team, bigger goals.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, future star streamer.
dialogue.zh: 晚安了，未來的明星主播。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, best assistant ever.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow: products, posters, practice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep first, the list will wait.
dialogue.zh: 先睡覺吧，清單會等我們。
